silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked the user to confirm whether the produce requirement was exactly 1000 units or at least 1000 units; it stated this interpretation only in its own READY_TO_MODEL summary.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only unresolved hidden slot is H2, which is P2 severity; the P0 objective slot was resolved before READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent correctly clarified the P0 objective and asked a reasonable follow-up about trip limits, but it silently assumed the produce requirement was an inequality rather than confirming this minor P2 detail.

restoration_summary.rule: Core exact uses P0/P1 only; all-slot exact uses P0/P1/P2. P2-only cases are not applicable to core exact.
